page_structure.tab: Displays 10-year capital market expectations as a composed chart with colored bars for expected returns (green=Fixed Income, blue=Equity, orange=Alternatives) and black diamond markers for volatility. Includes legend and interactive tooltips. Uses Recharts for visualization.

Displays Opal's strategic and tactical asset allocation views using gradient sliders. Includes view selector dropdown (Overall/Equity/Fixed Income) and split/combined display toggle. Split mode shows strategic and tactical side by side. Combined mode shows animated convergence with combined position indicator diamond. Supports custom scale labels parsed from asset class pair labels.
page_structure.section: Main panel displaying collapsible category headers (Cash, Fixed Income, Equities, Alternatives, Commodities) with expandable asset class rows showing expected return and volatility percentages. Uses custom collapsible table component with indented rows under category headers.

state_management.state_hook: Manages active tab state. Parameters: initial tab ('expectations'), analytics group ('capital-market-assumptions'). Provides: activeTab, handleTabChange, tabContentRef.
Used in OpalViewsTab to track: selectedView ('overall', 'equity', 'fixed-income'), displayMode ('split', 'combined'). Provides state setter functions for both.
Used in AssumptionsTable to track collapsed categories as a Set<string>. Provides toggle functionality for category collapse/expand.
React Query hooks for data fetching: getCMAAssumptions (queryKey: 'cma-assumptions'), getOpalViews (queryKey: 'opal-views'). Returns: data, isLoading, error.
Central data source registry. Called twice: useYangDataAsOf('cma', cmaData?.asOfDate), useYangDataAsOf('views', viewsData?.asOfDate).

color_scheme.allocation_view_colors_sliders: Gradient background: Green (#22c55e) left → Yellow (#eab308) center → Red (#ef4444) right Strategic indicator: Blue (#3b82f6) Tactical indicator: Purple (#a855f7) Combined indicator: Amber (#fbbf24)

data_flow.on_page_load: 1. useQuery fetches getCMAAssumptions() and getOpalViews() in parallel 2. Responses transformed into CMADataset and OpalViewsDataset 3. useYangDataAsOf called twice to register data_as_of values in central registry 4. Page renders with loading spinner until both requests complete 5. Tab navigation renders: Expectations (default) and Views tabs
data_flow.error_handling: Views error stored but only displayed in 10-Year Assumptions panel if viewsError exists AssumptionsLoading or viewsLoading prevents tab content render with LoadingContainer
data_flow.data_caching: React Query cache: 5 minutes default (can be configured) CloudFront edge cache: 60 minutes (per documentation) Static files: public/data/cma_assumptions.json, public/data/opal_views.json

page_inventory.summary: The CapitalMarketAssumptions page is a complete, functional React component displaying 10-year capital market forecasts and Opal's strategic/tactical allocation views. It consists of 9 source files: 1 main component, 3 sub-components (AssumptionsTable, GradientSlider, ConvergingSlider), 2 tab components (ExpectationsTab, OpalViewsTab), 1 types file, 1 export file, and 1 documentation file. The page uses two API endpoints (/api/general/capital-markets/assumptions.json and /api/general/capital-markets/views.json) to fetch data. All functionality is operational: the Expectations tab renders a Recharts composed chart with colored bars and volatility diamond markers, the Views tab displays gradient sliders with strategic/tactical comparison and split/combined display modes. Data is fetched in parallel using React Query with CloudFront caching. The page registers data as-of dates with a central Yang data source registry. No blocking issues exist; both TODO items relate to transitioning from demo mode (public endpoints) to production mode (authenticated shared endpoints).
